# MakeTransformations for chosen kinds: transformed strings are parsed into
# their kind (or target kind), and the transformations survive later
# rewrites (fixed point, GC), which reconstitute them.
builder prov
prim dt date-time n=When
prim u uuid
prim is integer-string
prim bs bool-string
str s unrestricted
arr a dt
cls c w:dt,u:u,i:is,b:bs,a:a,s:s n=C
top C c
finish printonrewrite
maketx kinds=date-time,uuid,integer-string,bool-string debugtx debug
fixedpoint debug
gc
print
xf 1
xf 3

# A kind without a transformation is an error.
builder
prim i integer
cls c i:i n=C
top C c
finish
maketx kinds=class
